 Is Carmelle already preparing for Eurovision performance in Bulgaria?
 MJ Felipe ,
 ABS-CBN News
 Published November 21, 2026 01:00 PM PHT 
 Philippines’ contestant Carmelle stands during media interviews ahead of the Eurovision Song Contest Asia 2026, at One Bangkok Forum in Bangkok on November 11, 2026. Lillian Suwanrumpha, AFP MANILA — Carmelle Collado is still on a high after emerging as the first-ever winner of the Eurovision Song Contest Asia.
 READ: CARMELLE bags Eurovision Song Contest Asia 2026 crown Collado is already back to work after her triumph in Bangkok, flying to Sydney for TFC's Pasko Festival 2026.
 “Hindi pa naman siya masyado nagsisink in sa'kin, pero happy naman po ako ito po yung first event ko po na makakabalik po ako sa Australia after winning Eurovision,” said Collado. “Nung last na punta ko po ng Australia, ang dami pong mga Pinoy so ngayon po, excited po akong makita kayong lahat ulit.”
 According to Collado, she has received congratulatory messages from her batchmates in Pinoy Big Brother, as well as Grammy-nominated P-pop groups BINI and SB19.
 ADVERTISEMENT
 "Yung BINI, yung mga ate ko nagmessage po. Yung SB19, si Kuya Stell nagmessage po siya sa akin. And Grammy nominated din po sila, grabe sobrang nananalo ang mga Pinoy," she said.
 As the winner of the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia, Collado is set to perform in Eurovision in Bulgaria next year. However, the artist says she has yet to start preparing for this performance.
 "Right now, focus po muna kami sa concert ko po. Kasi mauuna po yung concert ko sa January 29, and yung sa Bulgaria naman po is sa May pa naman po. Wala pa namang sinasabi na exact na date, pero sa May 2027," she explained. 
   Catch Carmelle Collado at TFC’s Pasko Festival 2026 at the Tumbalong Park, Darling Harbour, Sydney, Australia this weekend, November 21-22. × ⏸ Unmute Read More :
